# danduh.me

> Daniel Ostrovsky — AI Architect. Agentic systems, evaluation, governance,
> fine-tuning, MCP, and on-device/browser AI, mostly in JavaScript/TypeScript.

Daniel Ostrovsky is an AI Architect who writes and speaks about AI-assisted
engineering, on-device AI, system architecture, and the future of web
development. This file indexes the primary content on danduh.me for language
models.

## Courses

### Chrome's Built-in AI — from 0 to superhero
On-device Gemini Nano in the browser: no backend, no API keys, no data leaving
the machine. Every lesson ships with a runnable, framework-free demo.
Companion demo repo: https://github.com/danduh/chrome-ai-course
Hosted demos: https://windowai.danduh.me/

- [Introduction](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/introduction): AI in the browser, on-device.
- [Setup & the availability lifecycle](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/setup-and-availability): flags, availability() states, downloads, graceful degradation.
- [The Prompt API (LanguageModel)](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/prompt-api): sessions, prompts, streaming, parameters, tokens.
- [Structured output & tool calling](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/structured-output-and-tools): responseFormat, tools, the intent-loop workaround.
- [Multimodal: image input](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/multimodal): expectedInputs, content parts, drag/paste.
- [The Summarizer API](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/summarizer): key-points, tl;dr, headline, teaser.
- [Translator + Language Detector](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/translator-and-language-detector): detection and translation, on-device.
- [Live voice translation](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/live-voice-translation): Web Speech + the on-device Translator.
- [Writer & Rewriter](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/writer-and-rewriter): generate and transform text.
- [The Proofreader API](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/proofreader): grammar/spelling corrections with diffs.
- [Embeddings (SemanticEmbedder)](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/embeddings): vectors, task types, semantic search.
- [WebMCP](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/webmcp): the page as a callable tool surface.
- [Generative UI (MCP Apps)](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/generative-ui): tools that return sandboxed UI.
- [An MCP client in the browser](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/mcp-client): remote MCP over Streamable HTTP.
- [Observability & tracing](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/observability-and-tracing): instrumenting on-device AI.
- [Evaluation](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/evaluation): golden sets, LLM-as-judge, regression.
- [Shipping it: the compatibility matrix](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/shipping-and-compatibility): versions, flags, fallbacks, checklist.

## Blog

- [MCP 2.0 Is Mostly Deletion. That's The Good Part.](https://danduh.me/blog/mcp-goes-stateless): The 2026-07-28 Model Context Protocol revision goes stateless — the session is removed, application state becomes explicit handles, elicitation/sampling become Multi Round-Trip Requests, Tasks and UI move to extensions, and OAuth 2.1 gets hardened. What actually breaks, who has real migration work, and the per-call authorization gap it leaves unfixed. Topics: MCP, Model Context Protocol, stateless protocol, MCP tasks, MCP apps, MCP authorization, agents.
- [You Can't Make Your Company AI Native Without Dealing With This First](https://danduh.me/blog/ai-native-knowledge): Becoming an AI native company hinges on the one thing almost everyone misses — whether your organizational knowledge is structured, trusted, and accessible to AI at every step of the product lifecycle. Covers knowledge silos across tools, trust scoring (production code = ground truth), staged trust elevation, and temporal feature memory (GraphRAG / Graphiti). Topics: AI, architecture, AI native, knowledge graph, GraphRAG, context rot, institutional memory.
- [AI Is Building Code Nobody Can Maintain. You're Next.](https://danduh.me/blog/ai-amnesia-graphrag): Organizations ship code faster than ever — and forget faster than ever. How a GraphRAG-backed knowledge graph gives your org (and your AI agents) real long-term memory. Topics: AI, architecture, GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, institutional memory.
